sloka: एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं समाश्वसिहि मैथिलि ।किं करोमि कथं वा ते रोचते प्रतियाम्यहम् ।। ५.३५.८८।।।।
transliteration: etatte sarvamākhyātaṁ samāśvasihi maithili ।kiṁ karomi kathaṁ vā te rocate pratiyāmyaham ।। 5.35.88।।।।

translations.english: "Mythili, everything I intended to say has been narrated to you. Calm yourself down. What shall I do? Or else, tell me what pleases you. I shall go back.
